review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the quality-trend effectiveness labels at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (1,529 consecutive label pairs, 1 changed) and on a deterministic analysis whose 26 self-checks pass. The four forecasters it scores are imaginary and no forecasting model was run. The single observed change lies on the step from a baseline row to the first feeder run, so the draft concludes that this sample cannot show forecasting skill. Human subject review, learner trial, translation and publication remain pending.
